notes.title: Key Blend Update (1.2.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244739/44350a0d8c09c114e26711508c7dd91943f6f0eb.png[/img]

We're back again with an exciting update for [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b]. 

The curious jaded keys of [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] have received some great feedback and we're glad that you're enjoying this strange old piano just as much as we are. However, the keys are indeed jaded, and we have seen some requests for a way to reduce how old it sounds.

Ultimately, [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] is meant to sound old, and that's why we love it, but we have listened to the feedback. In this update, we've introduced the Key Blend slider, which allows you to clean up the sound to your liking. 

[h2]How it Works[/h2]

The slider is on 0 by default, which gives you the original Woodrow sound. Dragging it to the right blends Woodrow with an additional sound pack and subdues the resonant sound.

[b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] was made using an authentic, custom soundpack. The Key Blend slider introduces new sounds that are not recordings of the real piano that Woodrow was modelled on. These sounds are 3rd party recordings of an old but tuned piano.

The Key Blend slider essentially blends in tuned keys on top of Woodrow, and crispens the sound by simultaneously reducing the bass and volume of Woodrow. Note, however, that it does not fully tune Woodrow or turn off the "old sound", as that isn't what [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] is about.

We hope that this feature will give users some extra control to brighten and tune the sound when playing pieces that use the lesser tuned keys. For those who enjoy the original sound, you can simply leave the slider set to 0. 

[h2]Other News[/h2]

We recently released an update that adds scalable full screen, supporting most common resolutions. This is part of our continued commitment to making sure [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] works better than ever.

This update also includes a fix that automatically adjusts [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] into full screen mode if it detects a low resolution that isn't supported, to offer the best chance at compatibility. 

That's all for now. Thanks for reading

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244739/e5de686a250e1b806cb6590b5cc3767a51fc2a30.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 for Woodrow the Old Piano
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244739/af77ee1f15edc47c4e50f99163e02fb133eca393.png[/img]

[b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] has just received a care update for continued security and compatibility. It also includes a much needed new feature: [b]full screen mode! [/b]

The full screen toggle appears on the top menu with the other options. This means that [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] can now be natively displayed on most common resolutions, which is great news for those on particularly low or very high resolutions where the previous locked windowed mode wasn't ideal.

Thanks for checking in! That's all for now.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244739/215614de46f3e7e4e36daf154b8d45cb6104bc62.png[/img]

[h1]Flash discount![/h1]

Save 50% on [b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] for a short time. If you've been waiting to give this old timer a try, now is the perfect chance!

[b]Woodrow the Old Piano[/b] is more than just a playable piano. It's fully rendered in 3D and features a custom soundpack lovingly sampled from a real antique piano. It can also play MIDI files by itself, or can be hooked up to a MIDI keyboard device and played, such as a digital piano or a keytar.

This sale is for a limited time.

notes.title: Woodrow the Old Piano Patch v1.0.0
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244739/e5de686a250e1b806cb6590b5cc3767a51fc2a30.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244739/098c70fb0ca2bcc414870e6a5bd766c60ee62549.png[/img][/url]
Woodrow the Old Piano is receiving its first update to keep things smooth behind the scenes. This patch addresses some issues related to old runtimes, in particular a "random" stalling issue on launch.

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Woodrow would randomly not appear after launching
[*] Updated Steam and engine runtimes
[*] Removed outdated "EA" tag on interface version tag
[/list]

That's all for now. Keep slammin' those keys!
